<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">4</field><field name="MODE">INPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field></block>
      </next></block>

        <mutation else="1"></mutation>

        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field></block>
        </statement>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

instruction.text: Write a Blockly program for: 📏 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor & 3-Zone Proximity Radar.

target.explanation: Verified Blockly XML workspace program for '📏 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor & 3-Zone Proximity Radar' targeting arduino-uno. Configures initialization in the setup routine and periodic control logic in the continuous execution loop.
target.code:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="serial_begin"><field name="BAUD">9600</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">11</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field></block>
      </next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="serial_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">Target Distance: </field></block></value><next>
      <block type="serial_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="ultrasonic_read"><field name="TRIG">9</field><field name="ECHO">10</field></block></value><next>
      <block type="serial_println"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"> cm</field></block></value><next>
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="logic_compare">
            <field name="OP">LT</field>
            <value name="A">
              <block type="ultrasonic_read"><field name="TRIG">9</field><field name="ECHO">10</field></block>
            </value>
            <value name="B">
              <block type="math_number"><field name="NUM">30</field></block>
            </value>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="serial_println"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">⚠️ DANGER (<30cm): Sounding Alarm!</field></block></value><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">11</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field></block>
          </next></block></next></block></next></block>
          </next></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">11</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field></block>
          </next></block></next></block></next></block>
        </statement>
        <next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">400</field></shadow></value></block>
        </next>
      </block>
      </next></block></next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

target.explanation: Read a tactile pushbutton as a 3.3V digital input on GPIO4 to control an external LED.
target.code:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">

      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field></block>
      </next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="io_digitalread"><field name="PIN">4</field></block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field></block>
        </statement>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

target.explanation: Interactive digital decade counter! The Arduino Uno drives all seven segment bars (a-g on pins D2-D8) through common GND to render digits 0 through 9 with glowing LED precision. Each count transition triggers an audio chime on pin D10 and flashes the pulse LED on D13, while an on-canvas Pushbutton on D9 allows manual step increments.

instruction.text: Build a 📏 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor & 3-Zone Proximity Radar circuit using Arduino Uno.

target.explanation: Automotive 3-zone ultrasonic parking radar with acoustic frequency alarm! The HC-SR04 emits ultrasonic pings from Trig (D9) and Echo (D10) to calculate obstacle distance. Readings stream to Serial Monitor, while three zone LEDs (Green Safe on D13, Yellow Caution on D12, Red Hazard on D11) and Piezo Buzzer D8 provide instant visual and acoustic proximity warnings.
target.code:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="serial_begin"><field name="BAUD">9600</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">11</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field></block>
      </next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="serial_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">Target Distance: </field></block></value><next>
      <block type="serial_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="ultrasonic_read"><field name="TRIG">9</field><field name="ECHO">10</field></block></value><next>
      <block type="serial_println"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"> cm</field></block></value><next>
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="logic_compare">
            <field name="OP">LT</field>
            <value name="A">
              <block type="ultrasonic_read"><field name="TRIG">9</field><field name="ECHO">10</field></block>
            </value>
            <value name="B">
              <block type="math_number"><field name="NUM">30</field></block>
            </value>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="serial_println"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">⚠️ DANGER (<30cm): Sounding Alarm!</field></block></value><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">11</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field></block>
          </next></block></next></block></next></block>
          </next></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">11</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field></block>
          </next></block></next></block></next></block>
        </statement>
        <next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">400</field></shadow></value></block>
        </next>
      </block>
      </next></block></next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>
